figurative_meaning_en: Work or display done with pomp, ostentation, and enthusiasm
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে প্রচুর জাঁকজমক ছিল।
আমি সাধারণভাবে থাকতে চাই, কোনো জাঁকজমক নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Their wedding ceremony was full of pomp and grandeur.
I prefer to live simply, without any pomp and show.
note: This is a synonymous compound word (যুগ্মশব্দ) commonly used in Bengali to describe elaborate displays.
